newsitem.title: USA: COLOGNE TOP EX-JFK DESTINATION IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: COLOGNE TOP EX-JFK DESTINATION IN JUNE.

text.p: Lufthansa AG said it flew 12,165 tonnes of cargo from New York's John F. Kennedy Airport to Cologne between June 1996 and June 1997.

When asked if Cologne will remain as its top ex-JFK freight destination throughout 1997, a company spokesman said, "Frankfurt will continue to be Lufthansa's main world wide cargo operation for distribution of freight, however, we anticipate Cologne will stay at the top during the remaining summer months."
"Cologne does not have the same noise restrictions as Frankfurt, making it a more suitable gateway for particular integrators we have agreements with," he added.
Frankfurt headed the carrier's list of top originating gateways exporting cargo to the US through JFK, the spokesman said.
A total of 8,439 tonnes of cargo emanating in Frankfurt was transported by Lufthansa to the New York area during the 12 months in question.
